record.name: solar-string-data
record.description: Write StringData.json: every panel group sorted by name, with the selected strings whose two ends lie in it and their end coordinates. Choose design-json for the complete current design, including panel memberships, routes and metadata. Choose continuity-json for gaps measured between panel centres, or edge-clearance-json for gaps between verified panel outlines in a saved project drawing.

format.description: Choose endpoints, complete design, centre spacing, or edge clearance.

max_panel_pitch_m.description: For continuity only. Maximum allowed distance between consecutive panel centres in metres.

max_panel_edge_gap_m.description: For edge clearance only. Maximum clear distance between consecutive panel outlines in metres. Touching or intersecting outlines have zero clearance.
